name: Run a guardian operation
description: Executes one operation with the venue's authority. Thor only. Without `user`: v/ops/user/list or v/ops/user/info, to see who this venue's users are. With `user`: runs the operation inside that user's namespace on their behalf (user:sudo, this venue's own users only) — to look: v/ops/agent/list|info|sessions|session-read, v/ops/covia/read|list|inspect; to act: v/ops/agent/suspend {agentId} stops an agent at once and keeps all its state, v/ops/agent/resume {agentId} lets it run again. Anything else is refused, and the venue's own agents are out of reach. Every run is a recorded job.

operation.description: The full operation path, e.g. v/ops/agent/suspend.

input.description: The operation's own input, exactly as its schema describes.

user.description: Optional: a user DID of this venue. When present the operation runs inside that user's namespace on their behalf, and must be one of the namespace operations.
